operations.name: read_usb_status
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xC022
in ax, dx
ret
operations.returns: USB status in AX (bit 0 = USBINT, bit 1 = error, bit 5 = halted)

operations.name: read_usb_port1
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xC030
in ax, dx
ret
operations.returns: Port 1 status in AX (bit 0 = connected, bit 2 = enabled)
